entry.title: Dez Dam

groundCutout.basis: The arch, cliff-side tunnel mouths and modeled near-wall canyon collar occupy this outline. Adjacent native canyon terrain remains outside the mask.

terrainReference.basis: The model uses a nominal 354 m crest. An unchanged west-bank Terrarium sample at model-local [−182, −44] gives the matching model contact. The partial-fill review plane is 317 m. The production water sampler gives 364.72–377.19 m in the retained reservoir windows.

entry.note: Dez Dam’s thin double-curvature concrete arch, two east-bank spillway tunnel mouths and ledge, west-bank intake gallery, irrigation outlet mouths and occupied canyon contacts. The model uses a nominal 354 m crest. An unchanged west-bank Terrarium sample at model-local [−182, −44] gives the matching model contact. The partial-fill review plane is 317 m. The production water sampler gives 364.72–377.19 m in the retained reservoir windows. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
